ai.overview: AS Roma bring the lineal championship belt to Stadio Friuli on October 31st, 2026, having already defended it 8 times in their current reign. The belt passes to whoever wins on the pitch—no polls, no committees—and Udinese Calcio will look to claim it for the 22nd time in their history. With the two sides heading in opposite directions, Roma face a struggling Udinese side desperate to end a three-game losing streak.
key_matchups: Roma's attacking momentum (four wins in last five, including two 4–0 victories) against Udinese's porous defense that conceded 5 at Inter Milan and has lost their last 3 games
Udinese's home desperation with just 1 win in 5 games this season trying to reverse recent history—Roma have won 4 of the last 5 meetings
The belt's history between these clubs: 11 previous meetings with the belt on the line and Roma's 8 successful defenses already in this current reign
ai.betting_angles: The form contrast is stark: Roma are 4-0-1 on the season with their only blemish a 2–2 draw against Inter Milan, while Udinese sit at 1-3-1 and have lost their last 3 games. Roma have won 56 of 104 all-time meetings and took 4 of the last 5 head-to-head matches, including a 2-0 victory at home in November 2025. The Elo model favoring Roma aligns with both recent form and historical dominance in this fixture.
ai.prediction_writeup: Roma arrive in excellent form with 4 wins in their last 5 games, including dominant 4–0 victories over US Lecce and ACF Fiorentina. Udinese have lost their last 3 games and struggled defensively, conceding 5 at Inter Milan and failing to score in their most recent match against Cagliari Calcio. The head-to-head history heavily favors Roma with 56 wins to Udinese's 24 in 104 all-time meetings, and Roma took 4 of the last 5 encounters. With Udinese managing just 1 win all season and the Elo model backing the visitors, Roma should extend their belt reign to 9 defenses with a clean sheet road victory.
